values.meaning: cooldown reduction when Lunge stabs a target

mechanics.claim: Lunge deals basic damage but also triggers spell effects (spell damage), and does not apply on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunge'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Lunge applies on-hit effects but does not apply on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunge'' does not apply {{tip|on-attack}} effects but is special cased to stack {{tip|Energized}} upon hitting an enemy.

mechanics.claim: Lunge's damage can be dodged or blocked, negating its damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Lunge'' can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}}, negating its damage.

mechanics.claim: Fiora does not stab if the dash is interrupted.
mechanics.quote: '''Fiora''' does not stab if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
